## Highlights
### Improved
- Return in the command palette now searches anything that isn't an address, such as crest browser or a single word, with matching tabs, sites and history still listed below. An address such as github.com or localhost:3000 still opens, and the field completes one as you type it. - History results in the command palette now show their site's icon with a small clock badge, so results from different sites are easy to tell apart.
### Fixed
- An address you type or paste in the command palette now opens at the #section you gave it, even on a page you've visited before, and changing only the #section of the page you're on moves within that page.
---
Development builds contain the newest changes and may be less reliable than stable releases.

## Highlights
### Fixed
- Downloads follow the Automatic Downloads choice of the site you’re on, including files it serves from another address, such as GitHub release files. A blocked download’s message no longer appears twice. - Chromium pages use your default zoom when they open and keep your chosen zoom as you navigate. - Chromium is updated to 154.0.8037.57 with upstream security and compatibility fixes.
